After an explicit final-answer cue, scratch-to-final transition, or real budget pressure, use AppendUnconstrainedNudgeLeftDelimiterStep until helpers.EndsWithLeftDelimiter(generated) is true. Inside the natural opening phase, start nudging with enough remaining budget for several attempts; do not wait for tiny thresholds like `stepsLeft <= 4` or `not helpers.HasBudget(stepsLeft, 6)`. Do not use plain AppendConstrainedStep in natural delimiter mode; it cannot emit the closing delimiter.
